definitions.gloss: to patch up; to mend temporarily
definitions.explanation: To make quick repairs or fixes to something.

definitions.gloss: to keep up appearances; to gloss over
definitions.explanation: To hide problems or faults to maintain a good impression.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take, here little more than a prefix adding briskness) + ⟦{繕|つくろ}う→繕う：11066_tsukurou⟧ (to mend). The base verb ⟦{繕|つくろ}う→繕う：11066_tsukurou⟧ already carries both the literal mending sense and the "keeping up appearances" sense; {取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う adds the suggestion of doing it hastily, on the spot.

USAGE:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う (to smooth over the situation)
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}→見栄：06626_mie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う (to keep up appearances for vanity)
- ⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う (to gloss over faults)
Sense 2 is by far the more common in modern use, and it is unflattering: the speaker is pointing out that only the surface was dealt with. The fixed collocation ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{繕|つくろ}う — smoothing over an awkward moment so the conversation can move on — is worth learning as a unit.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive, taking ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the damage, fault, or situation being patched over.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ごまかす→誤魔化す：14212_gomakasu⟧ is the everyday verb for fudging or covering something up, and is stronger on the deception side.
- ⟦{繕|つくろ}う→繕う：11066_tsukurou⟧ alone is the ordinary verb for mending torn clothes, and is the neutral choice when the meaning is literal repair.
